from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OperatingProfitEntry(BaseModel):
    """One operating profit/loss figure extracted from a financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name the filing belongs to")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the figure applies to (e.g. '2021')")
    operating_profit_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric operating profit/loss value; losses should be negative")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g. 'Operating Income', 'Operating Loss')")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit used (e.g. '$', 'USD')")
    source_filing_fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year of the document this data was extracted from")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_profit_entries: list[OperatingProfitEntry]
